patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with high contrast backgrounds (dark, light, orange) create distinct visual breaks and guide the user down the page.
Extremely large, bold, sans-serif headings dominate the page, often occupying multiple lines, creating a strong visual hierarchy and impact.
A high-contrast palette of near-black and white is consistently used for backgrounds and text, punctuated by a vibrant orange for calls to action and key accents.

The initial hero section scrolls to reveal a full-screen, dark background with a dynamically animated neon brain graphic, transitioning from a subtle background element to a prominent interactive visual.
Section titles are often presented as large, uppercase, bold labels, sometimes with a preceding bullet point, providing clear navigation points and a structured feel.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent, light state to a solid dark background with a slightly modified logo and text color as the user scrolls past the hero section.

The hero content scrolls normally, but a background element (an abstract brain graphic) appears to parallax subtly. As the hero content exits the viewport, a new full-screen section with a dark background and an animated neon brain illustration (likely using canvas or Lottie) is revealed, creating a dynamic visual transition.
Content sections and individual elements within them are revealed with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, modern sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with generous line height, contrasted with clean, readable body text and uppercase, slightly tracked-out labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied to all interactive elements, buttons, and content cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with significant vertical spacing between major sections and a balanced density within content blocks, contributing to a clean and modern feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a stark dark/light color palette punctuated by a vibrant orange, combined with extremely large, bold, and modern typography. The central 'brain' motif, evolving from a subtle background graphic to a full-screen animated neon illustration, serves as a powerful and memorable visual metaphor for their 'engineering-driven' identity.
